entities.summary: Cultivation System, a pivotal event in the history of Netherlands (1839–1914). Part of Kingdom of the Netherlands & Colonial Empire. Triggered by Belgian Revolution and Treaty of London. This led to Thorbecke's liberal constitution transforms the Netherlands and WWI Neutrality & Refugee Crisis.
